intro: If Udaipur has been on your list, consider this your sign. Lakes, palaces and rooftop sunsets, all within reach of a short holiday.

sections.heading: Why visit Udaipur
paragraphs: Udaipur (Rajasthan) is known for its heritage, romantic and lakes experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is September to March.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Udaipur?

faq.a: Fly to Maharana Pratap Airport or take a train from Delhi, Jaipur or Ahmedabad.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Udaipur?
faq.a: Popular choices: Lal Ghat for lake-view guesthouses; Hanuman Ghat for sunset views; Fateh Sagar area for calm stays.
